your_games.title: 🎵 The Binding of Isaac pulls AI-generated music from its GTA VI parody run
your_games.body: A Reddit user found Suno metadata in the music for Repentance+'s GTA-themed daily run, added on 19 November alongside the console launch, and the game was review-bombed on Steam. Creator Edmund McMillen said he 'had no idea' generated music was used, and Nicalis patched the tracks out on PC on 21 November. The console patch has been submitted to Sony, Microsoft and Nintendo with no date yet, and recent Steam reviews are still overwhelmingly negative.

your_games.title: 🛒 The Switch 2 Mario Kart World bundle drops $50 for Black Friday
your_games.body: From 22 November to 5 December the bundle, with the console, a Mario Kart World download and three months of Switch Online, is $499.99 instead of $549.99 at the Nintendo Store and select US retailers. That temporarily undoes September's $50 price rise; the Switch Sports Resort bundle stays at $529.99. Select games such as Donkey Kong Bananza and Super Mario Galaxy + Super Mario Galaxy 2 are $20 off until 29 November. These are US prices, so check local retailers.

your_games.title: ⚔️ Darkest Dungeon II reveals The Butcher's Asylum, an arena DLC for 2027
your_games.body: Red Hook's paid expansion adds a standalone gladiatorial arena mode where you draft your team, face new enemy combinations and spin the Ringmaster's wheel for prizes. The Ringmaster herself becomes the 16th hero and is playable for the first time, after debuting in the first game's Butcher's Circus DLC. It's on Steam to wishlist now, with no exact date.

your_games.title: 🏜️ Dune: Awakening opens a short Blood and Ice test from 26 November
your_games.body: Funcom's Public Test Client for the free Polar Cap expansion runs from 26 to 30 November, kept short to limit spoilers and hunt critical bugs, before Blood and Ice launches on 1 December. The double mining output weekend ends today at 09:00 UTC (11:00 SAST), and a Water Crisis event follows several days after the expansion.

your_games.title: 🏆 Ocarina of Time holds No. 1 on the Switch 2 eShop as Isaac debuts third
your_games.body: Nintendo's weekly Switch 2 eShop chart keeps the Zelda remake on top, with Switch Sports Resort second and The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ entering at No. 3. Pokémon Pokopia, Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave and Final Fantasy Resonance are also in the top 20.

your_games.title: 🦉 Pokémon GO's Duolingo event details are out
your_games.body: Serebii has the full Timed Research tasks and rewards for the Pokémon GO x Duolingo 'Catch a New Language' event. You earn a code by completing a seven-day streak in Duolingo, and codes are available until 21 December. The Latin America International Championships also wrapped up yesterday with the GO, TCG and Pokémon Champions finals.

your_games.title: 📸 A GTA VI player says sharing an in-game nudist photo got them a 30-day PSN ban
your_games.body: The player says they lost PSN social features for 30 days after messaging a friend a photo of the game's nudist colony taken with the in-game camera. PlayStation's Code of Conduct bans obscene content in messages, so think twice before sharing GTA VI snaps over PSN. Sony and Rockstar haven't commented.

industry.title: A US congressman's Protect Our Games Act aims to keep bought games playable
industry.body: Rep. Maxwell Alejandro Frost announced the federal bill at a 18 November town hall. It would require developers to give players access to their own servers when official online services end, and keep purchased games playable as hardware and software move on. No bill text or number has been published yet, so coverage and enforcement are unclear. It drew fresh attention on X over the weekend.

industry.title: AION 2 puts cross-server trading behind a membership and a 20% tax
industry.body: NCSoft's World Market and World Exchange go live after maintenance on 25 November, letting players trade across servers in the same faction and region. Sales carry a 20% tax, are capped at 10 listings a day and are for Membership users only, as the team keeps banning bots and gold farmers.
